DSH-EasyRewrite is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Inline-edit and recall your own user messages in dsh web — lazily and seamlessly, with a version pager and per-session draft persistence.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-e72d55f3fce41d93de3f.html
